name: Single Parents
overview: Scripture reveals God's special care and protection for single parents and their children, emphasizing His role as a defender of widows and the fatherless. Believers are commanded not to afflict those without a spouse or parent, recognizing that children are a divine heritage entrusted to families. Trusting in the Lord’s guidance is essential for single parents, as He preserves and provides for those in vulnerable situations, turning away the plans of the wicked who would harm them.
